cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(samples LANGUAGES CXX)

# Tokotachi (pass the install location with -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<prefix>,
# or use FetchContent / add_subdirectory instead)
find_package(tokotachi 0.1 REQUIRED)

# <tokotachi-designer:begin id="tokotachi_sources">
# Sources generated by the Tokotachi designer (overwritten when regenerated)
set(TOKOTACHI_DESIGNER_SOURCES
    main.cpp
    main_window.cpp
    main_window_images.cpp
    settings_dialog.cpp
    parts/labeled_edit.cpp
)
set(TOKOTACHI_DESIGNER_INCLUDE_DIRS
    .
    parts
)
# <tokotachi-designer:end id="tokotachi_sources" hash="cc7632a7">

add_executable(samples ${TOKOTACHI_DESIGNER_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(samples PRIVATE ${TOKOTACHI_DESIGNER_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_compile_features(samples PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
target_link_libraries(samples PRIVATE tokotachi::tokotachi)
